messages:
anya: FYI — Acme opened an escalation. After our 03/19 canary they report the invoice parser stopped returning the `delivery_estimate` field. We passed internal invoice_testset. Copying payloads and notes below.

cs-bot: Canary deploy redwood-runtime@v2.1.3 -> v2.1.4 rolled to 10% at 2026-03-19 14:02 UTC :rocket:

jordan: Can you paste the customer prompt + example output and the exact model/runtime they hit?

anya: Customer prompt (redacted):
```
{ "task": "parse_invoice", "invoice_text": "...long invoice with shipping terms...", "schema": ["total", "items", "delivery_estimate"] }
```
Customer response (from their logs):
```
{"total": 142.50, "items": [...]}  // delivery_estimate missing
```
Our internal run (invoice_testset, redwood-runtime v2.1.3):
```
{"total": 142.50, "items": [...], "delivery_estimate": "2026-03-27"}
```
They included request ids: `req-REDACTED-ACME-1`, `req-REDACTED-ACME-2`. They say it started immediately after the canary.

oliver: Can you paste a minimal repro curl? I'll try to run against both versions.

anya: Curl (sanitized):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-infer","input": "<invoice long context>", "schema": ["total","items","delivery_estimate"], "max_tokens": 1500, "request_id":"req-REDACTED-ACME-1"}'
```
Note: customer convo context ~1400 tokens (they include previous messages).

oliver: Ran the exact payload against our staging v2.1.4 and I reproduced the missing `delivery_estimate`. Against v2.1.3 it returns the key as expected. :eyes:

matt: Any changes to function-calling or JSON post-processing in v2.1.4? Could be a pruning step when truncation happens.

oliver: I inspected runtime logs and stack traces. There's a new kernel-level truncation path introduced in the tokenizer/kv cache change that triggers at >1024 tokens. After truncation we call `normalize_json_response()` which currently drops trailing key-looking fragments. In short: when we truncate context, we erroneously drop trailing JSON keys instead of preserving them. Our internal invoice_testset uses ~400–600 token contexts, so we missed this.

jordan: That explains the eval mismatch — internal tests never exercised long conversational contexts. Good catch. Action plan: rollback canary to 0% immediately and ship a hotfix that preserves JSON-like trailing blocks during truncation.

matt: Rollback risk low. Canary at 10% via CD. I'll start rollback unless oliver wants to push a 1-line fix first.

oliver: I'll prepare a fix + unit/regression test (add a 2k-token invoice case that asserts presence of `delivery_estimate`). Target PR in ~1.5h. Patch will change truncation to keep final balanced JSON chunk when schema is detected.

anya: Customer asked for ETA — they're on dedicated infra and flagged this as high-impact. I'll tell them: rollback ETA ~15m once triggered, hotfix ETA 2–3h (PR + validation + canary).

cs-bot: Deploy job queued: rollback redwood-runtime -> v2.1.3 (job id job-8245). Started at 2026-03-19 14:45 UTC.

jordan: Also add a new eval that combines long convo contexts + schema checks to prevent this class of regressions. I'll own the eval addition.

matt: Owners: oliver -> fix+tests, jordan -> eval+deploy verification, anya -> customer comms. Marking P1 for CS and engineering. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll post the customer update now and link the rollback job. Will follow up after rollback completes.

oliver: Opening PR now — link: https://git.redwood/reviews/1234 (WIP). Tests added locally, running CI.

matt: After rollback completes, run a canary with a dedicated long-context invoice test before regradual rollout.

jordan: Noted. Will add a canary harness test.

anya: Summary sent to customer. Will keep thread updated.

matt: Thanks team — good quick triage. We'll follow up with a short postmortem once fixed. :eyes: :fire:
